description:
The development team at AcmeCorp has requested a staging copy of the production website so they can safely test changes before going live. You need to clone the existing virtual server 'acmecorp.test' to create a new virtual server called 'acmecorp-staging.test'.

Using Virtualmin's Clone Virtual Server feature, create a complete copy of 'acmecorp.test' with the following requirements:

- New domain name: acmecorp-staging.test
- Administration password for the new domain: StagingPass456!
- Clone ALL features: Website (Apache), DNS zone, Mail, and MySQL database

The clone should be a full copy including web content files, database data, DNS records, and mail configuration. Navigate to the acmecorp.test domain in Virtualmin and use the Clone Virtual Server option to accomplish this.

After cloning, the new domain 'acmecorp-staging.test' should appear in the Virtualmin domain list with all features enabled and web content copied from the original.
